functions.text: Programmable AND array feeding fixed OR gates, 7 product terms per output plus one product term that enables that output; all outputs active low. What each output computes is set by the fuses blown when the chip was programmed.

electrical.notes: Commercial figures (1983 handbook page 3-10): IOL 24 mA, IOH -3.2 mA (military 12 mA / -2 mA); ICC 120 typ, 180 max mA; input low current -0.25 mA max.

notes: How to read this chip: put it in a device programmer that supports the type and read the fuse map (only possible if the security fuse was not blown; the 1983 handbook, printed page 3-20, describes the security fuses). Save it as a JEDEC file, turn the fuse map into equations with a disassembler, and write those equations into a per-card file for this board position. Never put equations in this catalogue file: it describes the blank device. Pin names here are made up from the pin function shown on the MMI logic diagram (I = dedicated input, IO = output that also feeds back into the array, O = output with no feedback) plus the pin number, because the datasheet numbers the pins but gives them no names. The 8 rows of each output group on the logic diagram are 1 enable term and 7 OR terms (1983 handbook page 3-33). Card 3207 uses this type at 9E, 21E, 24B, 21A and 13C.
